tax.text: Calvert says people should keep more of their income and supports simplifying the tax code and lowering the corporate tax rate.
tax.quote: Everyone who works hard deserves to keep the money they earn

immigration.text: Calvert says the southern border must be secured, immigration laws enforced, and E-Verify made mandatory nationwide.
immigration.quote: First and foremost, we must have control of our border.

abortion.text: Voted against federal legislation protecting abortion access and for multiple measures restricting abortion coverage, abortion providers, or abortion procedures.
abortion.quote: A bill to protect the federal right to abortion and block the barrage of state bans and restrictions on abortion intended to impede or outright deny access.

energy.text: Introduced a resolution condemning state policies that restrict domestic oil production and increase gasoline prices.
energy.quote: The resolution calls out the California policies that restrict energy supplies and increase costs, which impact consumers – including the U.S. military.

housing.text: Helped advance legislation to expand housing supply, streamline permitting, and give communities tools to build more homes.
housing.quote: The package streamlines burdensome federal permitting processes that delay construction, equips communities with new tools to build more homes

immigration.text: Supported increased border-security funding and the Laken Riley Act, which provides for detention and deportation of undocumented immigrants who commit crimes.
immigration.quote: It’s simple: enforce our laws, secure the border, no amnesty, and put American safety first.

health.text: Voted for legislation intended to lower premiums by expanding private coverage choices, particularly for small businesses and workers.
health.quote: By expanding choice, cracking down on hidden costs, and empowering employers and workers, we can drive down prices and give families more control over their health care decisions.

energy.text: Introduced legislation to expand domestic geothermal production, reduce permitting barriers, and bring more affordable energy online.
energy.quote: For Californians facing some of the highest energy costs in the country, this relief can’t come soon enough.

voting.text: Supported the SAVE Act and voter-identification requirements to limit voting in federal elections to eligible citizens and verify voters’ identities.
voting.quote: I supported the Safeguard American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Act to ensure only American citizens can vote in American elections, and I support voter ID in California and across the country
